deployment.sentence: BF16 weights with a Q8_0 KV cache on llamacpp: 3.47 GB of weights, 262,144 tokens per stream, 44 full-length streams (computed) within 100.0 GB. Peak memory 126.7 GB.

energy.note: Each valid speed-cell window is measured on its own and the joules are summed. nvml-energy-counter is the GPU's cumulative energy counter read before and after the bench command. nvidia-smi-1hz-trapezoid integrates sampled power and is used only when the counter was not read; gaps longer than telemetry.max_sample_gap_s are not bridged. Invalid or unverified windows are excluded. GPU only: on a DGX Spark the CPU shares the 140 W SoC budget and is not counted. Not joules per correct answer, and not a wall meter. Null means it was not measured.

speed.bandwidth_ceiling_note: Derived from the configured spec bandwidth (273 GB/s) divided by approximate active weight bytes. Not a measurement. NVFP4/MXFP4 use 0.5 bytes per parameter and ignore scale overhead.

warnings: Peak memory was 126.7 GB, over the 100 GB budget. The plan's engine overhead was too small for this run: raise memory.overhead_gb.llamacpp by the difference.
Page cache was not dropped. The next model may see leftover file cache.
